import sys, json, subprocess, random, itertools, collections, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import exact_ref as R
import fuzz as F

def core_of(rib, ixps):
    agg={}
    for path, cnt in rib:
        p,looped=R.normalize(path, set(ixps))
        if looped or len(p)<2: continue
        agg[p]=agg.get(p,0)+cnt
    links=set()
    for p in agg:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): links.add(R.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    rounds, finals = R.peel(agg)
    core=sorted(links-set(rounds))
    occ=R.occurrences(finals, core) if core else []
    return core, R.scopes_of(core, occ), rounds, finals

def gen(rng, big):
    n_as = rng.randint(8, 22) if big else rng.randint(3, 9)
    asns=list(range(1,n_as+1))
    rib=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 30 if big else 8)):
        k=rng.randint(2, min(12, n_as))
        path=rng.sample(asns,k)
        if rng.random()<0.3: path=[rng.choice(asns)]+path
        if rng.random()<0.15: path=path+[rng.choice(path)]
        rib.append((path, rng.randint(1,20)))
    ixps=rng.sample(range(1,n_as+3), rng.randint(0,4))
    return rib, ixps

def run(trials, seed, big=False):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    stats=collections.Counter(); bad=0
    t0=time.time()
    for t in range(trials):
        rib, ixps = gen(rng, big)
        core, scopes, rounds, finals = core_of(rib, ixps)
        if len(core)>7: stats['bigcore-skip']+=1; continue
        perm=F.find_order(scopes, len(core))
        if perm is None: stats['wide-skip']+=1; continue
        doc={'version':1,'ixps':ixps,
             'rib':[{'path':p,'count':c} for p,c in rib],
             'priors':[], 'declared':[],
             'order':[[core[i][0],core[i][1]] for i in perm],
             'queries':[]}
        res=R.reference(doc)
        expected = res if 'error' in res else R.floats(res)
        stats['zero' if 'error' in res else 'ok']+=1
        inp=json.dumps(doc)
        pr=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=inp.encode(),capture_output=True)
        got=json.loads(pr.stdout)
        if not F.same(expected, got):
            bad+=1; stats['MISMATCH']+=1
            if bad<3:
                print('MISMATCH',t); print('in ',inp[:2000]); print('want',json.dumps(expected)[:1200]); print('got ',json.dumps(got)[:1200])
    print(stats,'bad',bad,'secs',round(time.time()-t0,1))

if __name__=='__main__':
    run(int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), len(sys.argv)>3 and sys.argv[3]=='big')
